signs.instruction: Extend index finger vertically upwards while keeping thumb and other three fingers folded into the palm. Palm faces outward towards the camera.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Extend index and middle fingers upwards in a clear V shape. Keep ring, pinky, and thumb folded firmly. Palm faces camera.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Extend index, middle, and ring fingers vertically upwards with slight separation. Thumb holds pinky finger folded against palm.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Extend all four fingers (index, middle, ring, pinky) straight upwards. Thumb folded flat across the center of palm.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Open hand fully with all five digits extended and spread naturally. Palm faces directly forward at camera center.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Non-dominant hand shows open 5-palm while dominant index finger points into the non-dominant palm center, indicating 5+1.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Non-dominant open palm held flat; dominant hand places two extended fingers (index and middle) across the open palm.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Non-dominant open hand facing forward; dominant hand places three fingers across the palm surface.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.instruction: Non-dominant hand open; dominant hand lays four extended fingers across the non-dominant palm.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: A
signs.instruction: Hold non-dominant hand open with palm facing outward. With dominant index finger, touch the tip of the non-dominant thumb.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: B
signs.instruction: Bring both hands together touching thumb-to-thumb and index-to-index, creating two circular loops resembling letter 'B'.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: C
signs.instruction: Curve dominant hand into a semi-circle C silhouette with thumb and curved fingers opposing each other. Palm faces sideways.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: D
signs.instruction: Non-dominant index points vertically upwards. Dominant index and thumb form a curved loop touching the non-dominant vertical stem.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: E
signs.instruction: Hold non-dominant hand open with fingers spread. With dominant index finger, touch the tip of the non-dominant index finger.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: F
signs.instruction: Place dominant index and middle fingers across the non-dominant index and middle fingers in a crosshatch / T-contact.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: G
signs.instruction: Place both fists together with dominant fist resting directly on top of non-dominant fist.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: H
signs.instruction: Non-dominant hand held flat horizontally; dominant open hand sweeps flat across the palm surface from heel to fingers.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: I
signs.instruction: Hold non-dominant hand open with fingers spread. Touch the tip of non-dominant middle finger using dominant index finger.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: J
signs.instruction: Start with dominant index finger at non-dominant middle fingertip and trace downwards into the palm and curve outward into J hook.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: K
signs.instruction: Non-dominant index points vertically. Dominant index finger hooks at the knuckle and presses against non-dominant index side.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: L
signs.instruction: Place dominant index finger flat across non-dominant palm, or extend dominant index and thumb at 90-degree L angle on palm.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: M
signs.instruction: Place three fingers (index, middle, ring) of dominant hand flat onto the palm of non-dominant hand.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: N
signs.instruction: Place two fingers (index, middle) of dominant hand flat onto the palm of non-dominant hand.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: O
signs.instruction: Hold non-dominant hand open with fingers spread. Touch the tip of non-dominant ring finger using dominant index finger.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: P
signs.instruction: Non-dominant index points vertically upwards. Dominant index and thumb form a loop touching near the top knuckle of non-dominant index.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: Q
signs.instruction: Non-dominant hand forms an O-ring with thumb and index. Dominant index hooks into the ring from below.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: R
signs.instruction: Dominant index finger curls into a hook shape and rests on top of the non-dominant open palm.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: S
signs.instruction: Dominant pinky finger hooks around the non-dominant pinky finger, interlocking them securely.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: T
signs.instruction: Dominant index finger touches the edge of non-dominant open hand near bottom edge, creating a T junction.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: U
signs.instruction: Hold non-dominant hand open with fingers spread. Touch the tip of non-dominant pinky finger using dominant index finger.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: V
signs.instruction: Dominant index and middle fingers form a V and rest across the open palm of non-dominant hand.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: W
signs.instruction: Interlock all fingers of both hands together pointing obliquely upwards, forming a double-peaked W silhouette.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.

signs.label: X
signs.instruction: Cross both extended index fingers over each other at right angles to form an X cross shape.

signs.label: Y
signs.instruction: Non-dominant index points vertically upwards. Dominant hand extends thumb and index to fork around the non-dominant index.
signs.data_provenance: Inherited source-project attribution; this image-to-label association has not been verified.
signs.licensing: The repository license is MIT; image-specific provenance and terms have not been verified.

signs.label: Z
signs.instruction: Form a Z shape by holding non-dominant flat hand horizontally and pressing dominant fingertips against it at an angle.
